scope: OWL-compatible direct peer mapping and AirDrop endpoint discovery

sourceModel.peerValidity: received MIF plus nonzero Version-TLV version and device class
sourceModel.neighborMapping: RFC4291 link-local IPv6 derived from source MAC and inserted directly

result.confirmed: OWL-valid MIF peers can be mapped directly without NDP or master admission. Bidirectional AWDL IPv6 UDP and complete AirDrop DNS-SD endpoint reconstruction succeeded in the same bounded session.
result.notConfirmed: The TCP connection to the exact advertised AirDrop endpoint timed out; TLS and file transfer were not attempted.
result.nextFocus: Inspect and correct the TCP SYN transmit/reply path to the exact scoped endpoint while retaining the direct OWL peer model.
